tags.name: SettlementOrderWeb
tags.description: Settlement Orders are a way to create settlements in bulk using settlement groups

tags.name: SettlementGroupWeb
tags.description: Settlement Groups allow users to define a groups of customers and/or metering points. Settlements can then be made using such groups instead of settling individual customers or metering points.

tags.name: SettlementDataCheckWeb
tags.description: Settlment Data Checks are jobs that can be created to check if the data required to calculate settlements for a given period is ready.

tags.name: ProductCategoryAssociationWeb
tags.description: Controls associating product categories with products

tags.name: ProductElementAssociationWeb
tags.description: Controls associating product elements with products

tags.name: MeteringPointBillingStatusWeb
tags.description: Metering point billing status jobs can be created to calculate information like what metering points are settled for a period and what volumes are settled vs not. Used by reports.

tags.name: JointPriceGroupWeb
tags.description: Joint Price Groups are referenced by joint price configuration rules, where they allow a rule to specify a group of product elements that specified invoice lines can be joined into.

tags.name: JointPriceConfigurationWeb
tags.description: Joint Price Configurations let users define a set of rules for combining multiple invoice lines into one in a settlement.

tags.name: CustomerViewGasMeteringPointTimeSeriesWeb
tags.description: All time series are sliced to the ownership period of the gas metering point in the hierarchy of the customer. Ie. only return data points that the customer is allowed to see.Not all time series are available in all countries. Requesting a time series that is not available in the the country of the top level customer returns a bad request

tags.name: BillingConfigurationWeb
tags.description: There is one BillingConfiguration per country. The billing configuration influences how billing is done in the country
